newsitem.title: GERMANY: Viag ups Schmalbach-Lubeca stake to 61.4pct.
newsitem.headline: Viag ups Schmalbach-Lubeca stake to 61.4pct.

text.p: German mixed utility Viag AG is to up its stake by 10 percentage points to 61.4 percent in the Schmalbach-Lubeca packaging producer, Schmalbach-Lubeca said on Monday.
Schamalbach-Lubeca said it was also planning to resume dividend payments in the business year 1996, and would report an annual profit of 50 million marks in the same year, as it previously announced.

Viag will take over Deutsche Bank's 10 percent stake in the company. Hanno Fiedler, management board chairman of Schmalbach-Lubeca, said: "Thus the optimisation of our product portfolio is being positively accompanied by Viag."
